summary.text: Trojan whom Achilles smote upon the ear so that the bronze spear-point passed clean through the other ear when the son of Peleus raged in the rout — distinct from `mulius-trojan` whom Patroclus slew, from `mulius-augeiad` whom Nestor laid low in the old Pylians–Epeians war, and from the spearman son-in-law of Augeias in that same tale.

story.text: Achilles drew nigh unto Mulius and smote him upon the ear, and clean through the other ear passed the spear-point of bronze; then smote he Agenor's son Echeclus full upon the head with his hilted sword.
